implementation: Finite named coefficient/proportion/day-count/month-count/person-count/piece-count operands only beside existing explicit arithmetic operators, in both prefix and suffix positions; detection copies retain existing NFKC/Cf/line-continuation behavior.
Complete ASCII whole-yuan plus optional one-digit jiao/fen is captured as one token and parsed in BigInt cents, then checked using the existing amount upper bound.

Fullwidth extra digits cannot silently pass whole-value numeric boundaries. A separate NFKC validation copy still recognizes unrelated fullwidth dates/counts; raw text and source coordinates are never rewritten.

limits: No actual model calls, training, deployment, holdout reads, full-project build or HTTP run were performed by this author task.
Named operands are a finite detection vocabulary, not a natural-language evaluator or an exhaustive grammar. Unknown operations are never computed by this patch.
Only ASCII integer yuan with ASCII single-digit jiao/fen is newly parsed. Mixed scripts, fullwidth subunits, decimal/scaled yuan plus subunits and malformed/extra subunits remain unavailable.
Parent owns the independent conjunction-range helper/wiring and candidate source-bound fullwidth edge handling; neither is included in this two-file parser/helper patch.
